priority_meanings.P0: Fix before a credible playable demo
priority_meanings.P1: Fix for dependable rules and usability
priority_meanings.P2: Complete or improve after the core loop

findings.title: Critical encounters do not execute their outcome
findings.evidence: pandemic_death + Continue left all five health values at 100, gameOver=false, phase=travel.
findings.cause: closeEvent only executes outcomes for type auto; critical has no resolving path.
findings.expected: Every event type resolves exactly once; critical effects can end a run.

findings.title: New Game carries progress from the saved run
findings.evidence: A save at 400 miles / day 21 produced a new setup state still at 400 miles / day 21 with five party members.
findings.cause: startNewGame constructs a game whose init immediately merges the previous save.
findings.expected: New Game starts from clean state. Loading is an explicit separate action.

findings.title: Automatic outcomes leave the display and save stale
findings.evidence: good_weather changed distance to 15 while the display and saved distance remained 0.
findings.cause: closeEvent applies auto outcome without updating travel, HUD, persistence, arrival, or terminal conditions.
findings.expected: Event effect, screen, log, save, arrivals, and terminal checks commit together.

findings.title: Pending encounters are lost on load
findings.evidence: Loaded van_breakdown kept its event id, lost its outcome function, and reopened travel with no modal.
findings.cause: JSON drops functions from currentEvent; loadGame does not reconstruct or reopen encounters.
findings.expected: Save serializable event ids and pending choice state; restore the same encounter.

findings.title: Rest resurrects dead companions and requires no food
findings.evidence: Rest with food=0 and a Deceased companion at health=0 changed that health to 15 while status remained Deceased.
findings.cause: rest adds health to every member and skips the food deduction when food is insufficient.
findings.expected: Death is terminal; resting has an explicit resource rule and affects living members only.

findings.title: Travel can consume more fuel than exists
findings.evidence: Aggressive pace with one canister traveled 30 miles and left fuel=-2.
findings.cause: travelDay tests fuel < 1 before reading pace and its 1/2/3-canister cost.
findings.expected: Validate the selected action cost; inventories stay nonnegative.

findings.title: A losing run recreates its cleared save
findings.evidence: A travel-day party death showed game-over, then left a saved phase=game-over.
findings.cause: gameOver removes storage, but travelDay subsequently saves state again.
findings.expected: Terminal transitions stop subsequent turn processing and use an explicit replay/save policy.

findings.title: Location actions ignore the declared activity list
findings.evidence: The first stop declares rest/hunt but offers all five location actions. Leaving its shop changes phase to travel.
findings.cause: Location controls are unconditional; leaveShop and completePurchase always route to travel.
findings.expected: Render permitted activities and return from the shop to its originating location.

findings.title: Talk to Locals has no immediate visible response
findings.evidence: The dialogue was added to eventLog while travel-screen, the only log host, was hidden.
findings.cause: talkToLocals writes to the journey log without showing dialogue on the active location screen.
findings.expected: Display the conversation where the action occurs.

findings.title: Companion controls are clipped at a common phone width
findings.evidence: At 430 px, character-screen scrollWidth=516 and Random buttons occupy x=442..516 outside the viewport.
findings.cause: Input rows only stack at <=414 px; the wider phone layout retains a 150 px label, input minimum width, gaps, and a button.
findings.expected: All inputs and buttons fit at 390, 414, 430, and 768 px.

findings.title: Keyboard and modal semantics are incomplete
findings.evidence: All four profession cards have tabIndex=-1. Event modal has neither role nor aria-modal and does not move focus into the encounter.
findings.cause: Clickable div cards and a plain div modal lack interactive semantics and focus handling.
findings.expected: Selectable backgrounds are keyboard-operable; dialogs manage focus and expose their role.

findings.title: Advertised profession powers are mostly descriptive text
findings.evidence: The developer receives one starting NFT. Collabs, developer repair discounts, prepper forage advantage, and barista daily coffee are not implemented.
findings.cause: Profession specialAbility strings are displayed, but the related action logic does not branch on profession.
findings.expected: Either implement the advertised differences or write descriptions that match the actual mechanics.

findings.title: Several inventory items lack a usable game action
findings.evidence: Seed bombs and kombucha can be bought but have no consumer in the published code. Parts and NFTs are used by two choice events; the HUD only shows money, food, fuel, days, and health.
findings.cause: Inventory, shop descriptions, and usable actions are not aligned.
findings.expected: Every purchasable item has a clear use and a visible count, or is removed from the shop.

findings.title: Foraging is repeatable without resource or health cost
findings.evidence: hunt has a 40% chance to add 5..24 food, advances 0.5 days, and consumes no food, fuel, seed bombs, or health.
findings.cause: Time alone has no recurring cost in this action; seed bombs do not participate.
findings.expected: Define a meaningful forage tradeoff and verify route balance; do not accidentally make infinite food the optimal loop.

findings.title: Victory and landmark artwork are file-browser screenshots
findings.evidence: static_game_over_win.jpeg and location_viral_landmark.jpeg are 409x1024 source-file browser screenshots, not scenes.
findings.cause: Incorrect image files were assigned to live content slots.
findings.expected: A distinct Portland victory scene and an actual roadside attraction scene.

findings.title: Encounter and location artwork contradict their content
findings.evidence: First-stop art says GAME OVER - THE VIRUS WINS. Breakdown art depicts a phone spiral. Heatwave art depicts a Wi-Fi outage. The pandemic image depicts rainy driving.
findings.cause: Several files have mismatched content; names and bindings were trusted without semantic inspection.
findings.expected: Verify every image against the location or event it illustrates.

findings.title: Desktop and phone play screens devote too much space to framing
findings.evidence: screen.active adds 50vh bottom padding. A 390 px travel viewport is dominated by square art, a long route heading, and a fixed HUD; action buttons are below the initial viewport.
findings.cause: Poster-first composition, long headings, fixed HUD, and oversized spacing were combined without a compact play layout.
findings.expected: Keep the current scene, essential status, next-stop distance, and primary action easy to reach.

findings.title: The exported README overstates and contradicts implementation
findings.evidence: README claims 10 events, a 10% daily event chance, dynamic prices and pace-dependent event frequency. Code has 9 events, a 30% chance, fixed base prices and no pace effect on event chance.
findings.cause: Documentation describes intended or invented behavior as implemented.
findings.expected: Rewrite feature and mechanics documentation from verified code and runtime behavior.
